name: Bucket Sort
description: Distributes elements into numbered buckets, sorts each bucket (with insertion sort), then concatenates. Excellent average-case performance for uniformly distributed data.
aim: Sort by distributing elements into buckets based on value range, sort each bucket individually, then concatenate all buckets in order.
howItWorks: Distribute each element into its bucket
Sort each bucket (typically with insertion sort)

time.bestCase: Uniform distribution — elements spread evenly across buckets
time.averageCase: k = number of buckets, n elements processed linearly
time.worstCase: All elements fall into same bucket — degenerates to insertion sort

complexity.spaceDescription: Storage for n elements and k bucket lists

realWorld: Processing sensor data with known uniform distribution
whenToUse: Input uniformly distributed over a known range
Can afford O(n + k) extra space
alternatives: Counting Sort — simpler for integers in small range
Radix Sort — better for integers with many distinct values
Comparison sorts — when distribution is unknown or skewed
